subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

8, 10, 17, 19, 35, 37, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Alternate series is followed here i.e

 
• First series → Each number is multiplied (2) and then (1) is added starting with first number.
 
• Second series → Each number is multiplied (2) and then (1) is subtracted starting with second number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aea1030ac7f36ea23f7bcea814def642167dc5d472e7edd671ade297fe54f02e.png] 

Hence, **"71"** is the correct answer.
